amendment_record.log_rules: The campaign log at HEAD names each link of sequence 2 to the tip in exactly one line of this form (an optional leading '- '), committed together with the link file and its rendering; no line names a link beyond the tip or another link of a sequence, and every line holding the marker 'Amendment chain link' has this form. Link 1 needs no line. On the history reachable from HEAD a link file is added once and never modified or deleted.

record_shape.description: How a link of sequence 2 or higher holds its fields: the keys beyond required_keys that every such link carries (built_keys), the shape of each field the verifier reads (fields), the sections whose file bindings are hashed (C8), the link-2 data state (C13) and the fold-0 record list of later links. The record builder writes this shape and the verifier reads it; each side is tested against this fixture and neither copies the other's values.

analysis_completion.reruns: Every test the bound refusal fixture names and the decision-fixture test pass at the link's commit (a fresh pytest), every test the previous link's fixture names keeps its function-closure SHA-256, and every rule policy, the analysis rule included, is recomputed in a fresh interpreter.

later_links.fut_files: A FUT entry binds the binding pointer file fut_seq<k>.json (format deepmzyme_ec_clean30_futility_pointer_v1, binding true, k from 2 to below the link's sequence, its fit chain a prefix of the chain before the link, the futility record's SHA-256) and the futility record it names (format deepmzyme_ec_clean30_futility_record_v1, the same decision, binding, the same fit chain) as repository files at the link's commit; a FUT record is never taken from the link's own statement.

required_bindings.description: Role table (finding: bound-at-build notes become required bindings): every link of sequence 2 or higher binds each role by SHA-256; the record builder refuses a record without one, and the verifier refuses the link (C8). Public roles are committed files, hashed at the link's commit and on the live tree of the tip. The private roles (private_roles, with the dry-run-v2 receipts dry_runs.receipts) are bound privately: every binding below one is {path, sha256, private: true} below private_root, a gitignored file that is never committed and is read from the verification repository's working tree; every other binding is public and never carries private.

shapes.corpus_bindings: {tables, union_fasta}: tables are fold_bindings, union_fasta is a file binding
shapes.file_binding: {path, sha256}: a committed repository file and its SHA-256; below a private role {path, sha256, private: true}: a gitignored, untracked file below PRIVATE_BINDING_ROOT
shapes.fold_bindings: folds '0' to '4' exactly, each a file binding or a non-empty object of file bindings

types.commit: a full commit SHA (40 lower-case hexadecimal digits)
types.file_binding: {path, sha256}: a committed repository file at the link's commit and its SHA-256; never flagged private
types.fold: key kind: exactly the outer folds '0' to '4'
types.keys: an object holding at least these keys, each of the given shape
types.map: an object whose keys are of the given key kind and whose values are of the given shape
types.private_file_binding: {path, sha256, private: true} and no other key: a gitignored, untracked file below the private root, read from the verification repository's working tree, never from git
types.private_path: a safe repository-relative path of a file below DeepMzyme_Data/campaigns/ec_class_vs_clean30_2026-10/ (gitignored; no '..', '.' or empty component)
types.relative_path: a repository-relative path without '..'; a folder ends in '/'
types.sha256_or_null: a sha256 value, or null for a file that is new in the link

attached_folder.created_by: the execution side at unpack, writable, before the view root becomes 0o555
attached_folder.name: whole_protein_pretrain

change_class_examples.name: analysis completion that edits a scientific file
execution change that repins the frozen gate
analysis completion that repins an analysis channel
execution change that keeps the pins

description: Interface contract of amendment 2 between the science files and the execution files (contract X1-X15). Both sides test against these names; a change here is a change of the contract.

cpu_replay.status: proposed name; the execution side implements it and the science side pins its source

record_builder.bind_roles: --bind NAME=PATH with a dotted NAME (a role of required_bindings, or a key below one such as inputs.f6_holdout.0 or inputs.f6_corpus.union_fasta) places the binding at that record path; a name below a private role is bound privately

build_inputs.dry_run_receipts: fold -> the dry-run-v2 receipt below the private root (a passed, real plan-v2 dry run of that fold on a clean tree), bound privately; fills dry_runs.receipts, and the receipts' common HEAD, an ancestor of HEAD, fills dry_runs.source_commit
build_inputs.plan_v2: fold -> the plan-v2 record written by plan-v2 (format deepmzyme_ec_clean30_fold_plan_v2); fills plans.v2_plan_sha256, and each plan_sha256 equals campaign.build_fold_plan_v2 in the live tree

computed_at_build.bound_files: every public bound file inside the repository, committed with the link; bound_files.decisions is the decisions file
computed_at_build.execution_file_set: every tracked src/ and scripts/ file that neither the composite pins before link 2 (Freeze 1 and link 1) nor source_changes name, from the live tree; amendment_rules.partition refuses a scientific or post-fit analysis role and the set must equal the draft's execution_file_set.declared
computed_at_build.pinned_analysis_functions: amendment_rules.function_closure_sha256 of each draft name in the live tree; the draft names equal amendment_rules.PINNED_ANALYSIS_FUNCTIONS and lie in post-fit analysis files
computed_at_build.pinned_execution_functions: amendment_rules.function_closure_sha256 of each draft name in the live tree; the draft names equal amendment_rules.PINNED_EXECUTION_FUNCTIONS and lie in execution files
computed_at_build.rule_policy_sha256: amendment_rules.rule_policy_sha256() (every registered rule, the analysis rule included)
computed_at_build.rule_text: the rule text of the reviewed document amendment_draft.md, its repository path and its SHA-256

record_builder.declared_execution_files: execution_file_set.declared of the draft is the closed list of execution files; the execution file set derived from the live tree must equal it, and execution_file_set.pending must be empty at build (a file outside the declared list is never an execution file)
record_builder.description: How ec_clean30.amendment2.build_amendment2 writes link 2 (amendment.json) once from the reviewed draft, the decisions file, the rule text and the build inputs (contract section Record builder).

private_bindings.file: a regular file reached without a symbolic link in any component below the repository root, inside the repository lexically and by its real path, below the root, not tracked by git (index or HEAD) and ignored by a pattern of a .gitignore tracked at HEAD, unmodified and in a folder that contains the file (git check-ignore -v without system, global or core.excludesFile excludes; .git/info/exclude and negated patterns are refused); a dry-run-v2 receipt names the fold view whose manifest SHA-256 Freeze 1 records
private_bindings.public: every other binding is public {path, sha256}, never flagged private and never below the root
private_bindings.record: path and SHA-256 only; no private content enters the record or the rendering amendment.md
private_bindings.shape: {path, sha256, private: true}, no other key

verifier.full_clone_only: verify_chain refuses a partial clone (promisor remote, partial-clone filter or promisor packs) and names check_chain_receipt
verifier.live_tree: only the tip is compared with the live tree
verifier.per_link_authentication: a detached checkout of the link's published source commit (phase3._baseline_authentication pattern); link 1 by the unchanged freeze.verify_s1_amendment there
verifier.precedence_helpers: ec_clean30.amendment_chain:record_precedence_problems and require_record_precedence (keyword repo): a record under a chain is made at the commit that published the chain's last scientific link or a descendant (git_head or provenance.git.head) that is published on origin/main; its created_utc is a secondary check
verifier.private_bindings: C8 and C11 read every binding below a private role from the verification repository's working tree, never from git, and refuse one that is absent, does not hash, has a symbolic link in its path, lies outside the private root or is tracked at the link's commit; a private role bound publicly and a public binding flagged private are refused; a nested verification in a checkout reads them from the outermost verification repository, whose root the parent passes as an argument of the fixed chain probe (never an environment variable); C11 also requires each receipt to name the fold view whose manifest SHA-256 Freeze 1 records and carries that SHA-256 in dry_run_evidence, which the view binding compares without reading the private receipt

receipt_check.partial_clone: works in a git clone --filter=blob:none (checked-out files, commits and trees only)
rechecks: HEAD is the receipt's HEAD, or a published descendant that changes only execution files
every link file and rendering has its receipt bytes
the live scientific and post-fit analysis pins and the pinned execution functions hold
every public file the tip binds hashes on the live tree; the receipt's public and private bindings equal those of the tip link file; private bindings are never read (a pod holds none)
the verifier files equal the receipt's
receipt_check.refuses: a receipt made with require_published=False (draft) and any receipt of an unpublished chain
receipt_check.returns: the same keys as verify_chain, read from the receipt

verifier.shared_rules: ec_clean30.amendment_rules (r_cmd_v2_check, partition, function_closure_sha256, check_change_class, check_analysis_completion, scientific_identity)
